description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSubordinateAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It provides REST API endpoints for managing subordinate employees, including listing, adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting subordinate relationships for a specific employee. The class leverages various services and models to handle subordinate reporting methods, with OpenAPI annotations documenting the API endpoints.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing subordinate relationships of employees, including listing, creation, retrieval by ID, updating, and deletion. Implements CRUD operations with validation, service integration, and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list subordinates of a specified employee, applying filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new subordinate relationship for an employee.

methods.name: setSubordinateParams
methods.description: Sets subordinate details in a ReportTo entity based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'get all subordinates' endpoint.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove subordinate relationships for a specific employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subordinate record by employee and subordinate IDs.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Parses and returns employee number and subordinate ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single subordinate.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update subordinate's reporting method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a subordinate record.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for employee number parameter.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for reporting method ID parameter.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdsRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for subordinate ID array parameter.
